folded.subject: of them

spans.text: They satisfy you with their mouths, but their hearts refuse [compliance], and most of them are defiantly disobedient.

folded.id: of water|for|the pilgrim and the maintenance of al-masjid al-haram equal to [the deeds of] one who believes in allah and the last day and strives in the cause of allah?
folded.subject: of water
folded.object: the pilgrim and the maintenance of al-Masjid al-Haram equal to [the deeds of] one who believes in Allah and the Last Day and strives in the cause of Allah?

spans.text: [19] AR: ۞ أَجَعَلْتُمْ سِقَايَةَ ٱلْحَآجِّ وَعِمَارَةَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ كَمَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَجَٰهَدَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوُۥنَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ EN: Have you made the providing of water for the pilgrim and the maintenance of al-Masjid al-Haram equal to [the deeds of] one who believes in Allah and the Last Day and strives in the cause of Allah?

folded.id: satisfy you|with|their mouths
folded.subject: satisfy you

spans.text: They satisfy you with their mouths, but their hearts refuse [compliance], and most of them are defiantly disobedient.

folded.id: so complete|for|them their treaty until their term [has ended]
folded.subject: so complete
folded.object: them their treaty until their term [has ended]

spans.text: [4] AR: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ عَٰهَدتُّم مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنقُصُوكُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَمْ يُظَٰهِرُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ أَحَدًۭا فَأَتِمُّوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِمْ عَهْدَهُمْ إِلَىٰ مُدَّتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ EN: Excepted are those with whom you made a treaty among the polytheists and then they have not been deficient toward you in anything or supported anyone against you; so complete for them their treaty until their term [has ended].

folded.id: that you|will|not cause failure to allah
folded.subject: that you

spans.text: So if you repent, that is best for you; but if you turn away - then know that you will not cause failure to Allah.

[16] AR: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَن تُتْرَكُوا۟ وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا رَسُولِهِۦ وَلَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلِيجَةًۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ EN: Do you think that you will be left [as you are] while Allah has not yet made evident those among you who strive [for His cause] and do not take other than Allah, His Messenger and the believers as intimates?

folded.id: that|is|because they are a people who do not know
folded.subject: That
folded.object: because they are a people who do not know

spans.text: That is because they are a people who do not know.

folded.id: that|is|best for you
folded.subject: that

spans.text: So if you repent, that is best for you; but if you turn away - then know that you will not cause failure to Allah.

folded.id: the fire|they|will abide eternally
folded.subject: the Fire

spans.text: [For] those, their deeds have become worthless, and in the Fire they will abide eternally.

folded.id: their oaths|and|determined to expel the messenger
folded.subject: their oaths

spans.text: [13] AR: أَلَا تُقَٰتِلُونَ قَوْمًۭا نَّكَثُوٓا۟ أَيْمَٰنَهُمْ وَهَمُّوا۟ بِإِخْرَاجِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَهُم بَدَءُوكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۚ أَتَخْشَوْنَهُمْ ۚ فَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَوْهُ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ EN: Would you not fight a people who broke their oaths and determined to expel the Messenger, and they had begun [the attack upon] you the first time?

folded.id: then they|are|your brothers in religion
folded.subject: then they

spans.text: [11] AR: فَإِن تَابُوا۟ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ ۗ وَنُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍۢ يَعْلَمُونَ EN: But if they repent, establish prayer, and give zakah, then they are your brothers in religion; and We detail the verses for a people who know.

folded.id: there be|for|the polytheists a treaty in the sight of allah and with his messenger
folded.subject: there be
folded.object: the polytheists a treaty in the sight of Allah and with His Messenger

spans.text: [7] AR: كَيْفَ يَكُونُ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ عَهْدٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ رَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ عَٰهَدتُّمْ عِندَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ۖ فَمَا ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ لَكُمْ فَٱسْتَقِيمُوا۟ لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ EN: How can there be for the polytheists a treaty in the sight of Allah and with His Messenger, except for those with whom you made a treaty at al-Masjid al-Haram?

folded.id: there|are|no oaths [sacred] to them
folded.subject: there

spans.text: [12] AR: وَإِن نَّكَثُوٓا۟ أَيْمَٰنَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ عَهْدِهِمْ وَطَعَنُوا۟ فِى دِينِكُمْ فَقَٰتِلُوٓا۟ أَئِمَّةَ ٱلْكُفْرِ ۙ إِنَّهُمْ لَآ أَيْمَٰنَ لَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَنتَهُونَ EN: And if they break their oaths after their treaty and defame your religion, then fight the leaders of disbelief, for indeed, there are no oaths [sacred] to them; [fight them that] they might cease.

folded.id: they|are|not equal in the sight of allah
folded.subject: They
folded.object: not equal in the sight of Allah

spans.text: They are not equal in the sight of Allah.

folded.id: this|is|a declaration of] disassociation
folded.subject: This

spans.text: [1] AR: بَرَآءَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ عَٰهَدتُّم مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ EN: [This is a declaration of] disassociation, from Allah and His Messenger, to those with whom you had made a treaty among the polytheists.

folded.id: to those|with|whom you had made a treaty among the polytheists
folded.subject: to those
folded.object: whom you had made a treaty among the polytheists

spans.text: [1] AR: بَرَآءَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ عَٰهَدتُّم مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ EN: [This is a declaration of] disassociation, from Allah and His Messenger, to those with whom you had made a treaty among the polytheists.

folded.id: you cannot|cause|failure to allah and that allah will disgrace the disbelievers
folded.subject: you cannot
folded.object: failure to Allah and that Allah will disgrace the disbelievers

spans.text: [2] AR: فَسِيحُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍۢ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِى ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْزِى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ EN: So travel freely, [O disbelievers], throughout the land [during] four months but know that you cannot cause failure to Allah and that Allah will disgrace the disbelievers.
